audit.why: EVEN / 6-10 with a 7/10 carry rating fits a lane Nautilus owns for three levels and then loses to armour stacking. The 55.88% figure rests on 34 Emerald+ games; the packet flags it as contradicting the chart, and fixing the chart rather than the rating is the right resolution since the prose agrees with the chart's corrected form.
audit.corrected: No change to diff, tone, diffRating or carryRating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows named the wrong winner in both layers: Level 1 said Skill against a why describing a favourable trade, Levels 2 and 3 said Malphite against whys that literally begin 'Even Skill at 2' and 'Genuinely even', and Levels 4-5 and Level 6 said Skill against whys giving both stages to Malphite.
audit.why: whys[0] 'makes the trade favorable ... step up and auto-trade'; whys[1] 'Even Skill at 2'; whys[2] 'Genuinely even'; whys[3] 'a dedicated armor tank shrugs off your front-loaded poke'; whys[4] 'his R is unstoppable and outranges your Q'. The packet chart and the mirror audit both read Nautilus/Skill/Skill/Malphite/Malphite/Malphite/Malphite.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Nautilus (rating 7/10), rows 1 and 2 to Skill, rows 3 and 4 to Malphite, all as matched full+content pairs, with five why strings rewritten to name the real mechanism. Existing ratings already fit the new owners on rows 1-4.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that the page names none of Malphite's abilities, and three decisive numbers were absent: Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his maximum health and recharges out of combat, Unstoppable Force reaches 1000 against Depth Charge's 825 on a 130s rank-1 cooldown, and Thunderclap plus Ground Slam are what make his autos and attack-speed cut hurt.
audit.why: enemyKit P: 'shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges' — chipping that off before committing is the concrete instruction the page was missing. enemyKit R range 1000, cd 130/115/100 vs ownerKit R range 825: he opens the fight, you answer. enemyKit W carries autoReset and onHit; E cuts attack speed on a flat 7s and scales its damage off his armour.
audit.corrected: Granite Shield's 10% max-HP absorb written into dosFull[0].d; the 1000-vs-825 range gap and the 130s cooldown into report[5].t and phases[4].why; Thunderclap and Ground Slam named in dontsFull[0].d.
sources: enemyKit P/R/W/E text, ranges, cooldowns and flags

edits.before: Passive-root auto trades win the first exchanges. Identify how Malphite contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Passive-root auto trades win the first exchanges — Seismic Shard is his only tool before Thunderclap and it does not out-damage you.

edits.before: Hook threat changes where he can stand forever. Only take the trade when Malphite's Unstoppable Force is down.
edits.after: Even at 2: your shield and Riptide fight Thunderclap's armour and autos, and neither side has a kill window.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Malphite must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Even at 3 — your pull-into-root pins him, but Thunderclap's armour is already blunting the physical half of your chip.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Unstoppable Force's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Thunderclap stacks real armour here and Granite Shield eats 10% of his max HP every few seconds — your front-loaded poke stops landing.

edits.before: Depth Charge is an unmissable point-click knockup — the all-in always starts. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Malphite's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force reaches 1000 to Depth Charge's 825 and arrives first — never stand where his R reaches with his jungler unaccounted for.

edits.before: His engage. Q-peel when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Granite Shield is 10% of his max HP — chip it off before you commit.

edits.before: That is Malphite's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thunderclap arms aftershocks on his autos and Ground Slam cuts your attack speed.

edits.before: Track Malphite's Unstoppable Force: His engage. Q-peel when down. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 and reaches 1000 to your Depth Charge's 825 — he opens first.

notes: I did NOT write the missingInteractions claim that Dredge Line 'shuts off' Unstoppable Force. Riot's text calls Malphite's R a high-speed launch and nothing in either kit says a hook cancels it; the derived flag on Nautilus's Q even asserts it 'creates terrain', which contradicts Riot's own description. The mirror audit refused the same claim. Also left alone: whys[6] and late recommend Thornmail/Frozen Heart as HIS items, which is correct, but the page never notes that Ground Slam's damage scales off his armour — so the more armour he buys, the harder his E hits. That is worth adding when a length-neutral slot exists.
